policies.policy_title: Cut Employee National Insurance
policies.stated: The Conservative Party commits to cutting the main rate of employee National Insurance from 12% to 6% by April 2027, representing a total tax cut of £1,350 for the average worker on £35,000.

source.quote: Cut tax for workers by taking another 2p off employee National Insurance so that we will have halved it from 12% at the beginning of this year to 6% by April 2027, a total tax cut of £1,350 for the average worker on £35,000 – and the next step in our long-term ambition to end the double tax on work when financial conditions allow.

policies.policy_title: Abolish Self-Employed National Insurance
policies.stated: The Conservative Party pledges to abolish the main rate of self-employed National Insurance entirely by the end of the next Parliament, building on the abolition of Class 2 contributions from April this year.

source.quote: For the very smallest businesses, the four million people who are self-employed, we will abolish the main rate of National Insurance entirely by the end of the next Parliament. … This is a massive simplification of the tax system which means that 93% of self-employed people – four million of them – will no longer pay self-employed National Insurance. This will not affect their entitlement to the State Pension.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Triple Lock Plus for Pensioners
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce a new Triple Lock Plus, guaranteeing that both the State Pension and the tax-free allowance for pensioners always rise with the highest of inflation, earnings, or 2.5%, ensuring the new State Pension does not get dragged into income tax.

source.quote: Cut tax for pensioners with the new Triple Lock Plus, guaranteeing that both the State Pension and the tax free allowance for pensioners always rise with the highest of inflation, earnings or 2.5% – so the new State Pension doesn’t get dragged into income tax.

policies.policy_title: Expand Free Childcare for Working Parents
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will deliver the largest ever expansion of childcare, providing 30 hours of free childcare a week for working parents from when their child is nine months old until they start school by September 2025, saving eligible families an average of £6,900 per year.

source.quote: Give working parents 30 hours of free childcare a week from when their child is nine months old to when they start school, saving eligible families an average of £6,900 per year. ...From September 2025, all eligible parents with children from nine months old to when they start school will be able to access 30 hours of free childcare a week.

policies.policy_title: Reform Child Benefit Household Income Threshold
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will end the unfairness in Child Benefit by moving to a household system, so families don't start losing Child Benefit until their combined income reaches £120,000, benefitting over 700,000 households.

source.quote: End the unfairness in Child Benefit by moving to a household system, so families don’t start losing Child Benefit until their combined income reaches £120,000 – saving the average family which benefits £1,500.

policies.policy_title: Mandatory National Service for 18-Year-Olds
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce mandatory National Service for all school leavers at 18, offering a choice between a competitive year-long military placement or 25 days a year of civic service roles, backed by a Royal Commission and funding rising to £2.5 billion.

source.quote: Give young people the skills and opportunities they deserve by introducing mandatory National Service for all school leavers at 18, with the choice between a competitive placement in the military or civic service roles.

policies.policy_title: Fund 100,000 Apprenticeships by Curbing Poor University Degrees
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will fund 100,000 high-quality apprenticeships for young people by changing the law to close university courses with high dropout rates or poor graduate outcomes, protecting students and taxpayers.

source.quote: Fund 100,000 high-quality apprenticeships for young people, paid for by curbing the number of poor-quality university degrees that leave young people worse off. ...We will fund this by changing the law to close university courses in England with the worst outcomes for their students.

policies.policy_title: Ban Mobile Phones in Schools
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will require schools to ban the use of mobile phones during the school day, putting existing guidance on a statutory footing and providing funding for implementation.

source.quote: Protect children by requiring schools to ban the use of mobile phones during the school day... We will put our guidance on banning mobile phones in the school day on a statutory footing which will require all schools to operate a ban, as the best schools already do.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Advanced British Standard
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will transform 16-19 education by introducing the Advanced British Standard, building on A Levels and T Levels to provide a broader education with more time in the classroom and requiring English and maths study up to 18.

source.quote: Transform 16-19 education by introducing the Advanced British Standard, enabling young people to receive a broader education and removing the artificial divide between academic and technical learning. ...Every young person will spend more time in the classroom, learning more subjects, including English and maths to 18...

policies.policy_title: Boost Defence Spending to 2.5% of GDP
policies.stated: The Conservative Party commits to boosting defence spending to 2.5% of GDP by 2030, supported by a fully funded plan, to protect British interests and strengthen the UK's position in NATO.

source.quote: Boost defence spending to our new NATO standard of 2.5% of GDP by 2030, so we can protect British interests at home and abroad in an increasingly hostile world.

policies.policy_title: Introduce a Legal Cap on Migration
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce a binding, legal cap on migration, specifically for work and family visas, ensuring that numbers fall every year of the next Parliament to protect public services and housing, with Parliament voting annually on the level.

source.quote: Introduce a legal cap on migration to guarantee that numbers will fall every year, so public services are protected while bringing in the skills our businesses and NHS needs.

policies.policy_title: Stop Illegal Migrants by Removing to Rwanda
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will establish a deterrent by continually removing illegal migrants to Rwanda with regular flights, starting in July, and bringing the Illegal Migration Act into force to end legal challenges and clear the asylum backlog within six months.

source.quote: Stop the boats by removing illegal migrants to Rwanda. ...We will run a relentless, continual process of permanently removing illegal migrants to Rwanda with a regular rhythm of flights every month, starting this July, until the boats are stopped.

policies.policy_title: Increase NHS Spending and Workforce
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will increase NHS spending above inflation every year, recruiting 92,000 more nurses and 28,000 more doctors by the end of the next Parliament, and driving up productivity through technology and moving care closer to homes via Pharmacy First, new GP surgeries, and Community Diagnostic Centres.

source.quote: Increase NHS spending above inflation every year, recruiting 92,000 more nurses and 28,000 more doctors, driving up productivity in the NHS and moving care closer to people’s homes through Pharmacy First, new and modernised GP surgeries and more Community Diagnostic Centres.

policies.policy_title: Clarify Biological Sex in Equality Act
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce primary legislation to clarify that the protected characteristic of sex in the Equality Act means biological sex, ensuring that single-sex services and spaces can be provided and legislating that an individual can only have one legal sex.

source.quote: Protect female-only spaces and competitiveness in sport by making clear that sex means biological sex in the Equality Act. ...The next Conservative Government will introduce primary legislation to clarify that the protected characteristic of sex in the Equality Act means biological sex.

policies.policy_title: Deliver 1.6 Million Homes and Support First-Time Buyers
policies.stated: The Conservative Party commits to delivering 1.6 million homes in England by abolishing legacy EU 'nutrient neutrality' rules, fast-tracking homes on urban brownfield land, raising density in inner London, and creating urban development corporations. They will also make Stamp Duty permanent for first-time buyers up to £425,000 and launch a new Help to Buy scheme.

source.quote: Deliver 1.6 million well-designed homes in the right places while protecting our countryside, permanently abolish Stamp Duty for homes up to £425,000 for first time buyers and introduce a new Help to Buy scheme. ...Abolishing the legacy EU ‘nutrient neutrality’ rules to immediately unlock the building of 100,000 new homes...

policies.policy_title: Recruit 8,000 More Police Officers
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will recruit 8,000 more full-time, fully warranted police officers to ensure a new police officer for every neighbourhood, dedicated to community patrolling and catching criminals.

source.quote: Recruit 8,000 more full-time, fully warranted police officers to ensure a new police officer for every neighbourhood.

policies.policy_title: Cut Anti-Social Behaviour
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will cut anti-social behaviour in town centres by rolling out Hotspot Policing to all forces, expanding community payback, and legislating to evict social tenants who repeatedly disrupt neighbours.

source.quote: Cut anti-social behaviour in town centres by rolling out Hotspot Policing, expanding community payback and legislating to evict social tenants who repeatedly disrupt their neighbours.

policies.policy_title: Invest £36 Billion in Local Transport Infrastructure
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will invest £36 billion saved from cancelling the second phase of HS2 into local roads, rail, and buses to drive regional growth, including £8.3 billion to fill potholes and resurface roads, and additional funding for smaller cities, towns, and city regions.

source.quote: Invest £36 billion in local roads, rail and buses to drive regional growth, including £8.3 billion to fill potholes and resurface roads, funded by cancelling the second phase of HS2.

policies.policy_title: Back Drivers with Policy Reforms
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce a 'Backing Drivers Bill' to stop road pricing, reverse the London Mayor's ULEZ expansion, and require local referendums for new 20mph zones and Low Traffic Neighbourhoods.

source.quote: Back drivers by stopping road pricing, reversing the London Mayor’s ULEZ expansion and applying local referendums to new 20mph zones and Low Traffic Neighbourhoods.

policies.policy_title: Support Farmers and Food Security
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will back farmers by increasing the UK-wide farming budget by £1 billion over the Parliament, introducing a legally binding target for food security, improving public sector procurement of local food, and reforming planning to fast-track farm infrastructure.

source.quote: Champion our rural communities by backing farmers with a legal target and additional investment for food security, and protecting our best agricultural land from solar farms. ...Increase the UK-wide farming budget by £1 billion over the Parliament, ensuring it rises by inflation in every year.

policies.policy_title: Maintain Income Tax and VAT Rates
policies.stated: The Conservative Party commits to not raising the rate of income tax or VAT in the next Parliament, as part of its plan to cut taxes responsibly.

source.quote: As well as cutting National Insurance for 29 million people, we will also not raise the rate of income tax or VAT.

policies.policy_title: Maintain National Living Wage
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will maintain the National Living Wage in each year of the next Parliament at two-thirds of median earnings, which is forecast to rise to around £13 per hour.

source.quote: We will maintain the National Living Wage in each year of the next Parliament at two-thirds of median earnings. On current forecasts, that would mean it rising to around £13 per hour...

policies.policy_title: Pensions Tax Guarantee
policies.stated: The Conservative Party commits to a new Pensions Tax Guarantee, pledging not to introduce any new taxes on pensions, maintaining the 25% tax-free lump sum, preserving tax relief on pension contributions at marginal rates, and not extending National Insurance to employer pension contributions.

source.quote: Under our new Pensions Tax Guarantee, the Conservatives will not introduce any new taxes on pensions. We will maintain the 25% tax free lump sum and maintain tax relief on pension contributions at their marginal rate. We will not extend National Insurance to employer pension contributions.

policies.policy_title: Maintain Pensioner Benefits
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will maintain all current pensioner benefits, including free bus passes, Winter Fuel Payments, free prescriptions, and TV licences.

source.quote: We will maintain all current pensioner benefits, including free bus passes, Winter Fuel Payments, free prescriptions and TV licences.

policies.policy_title: Expand Wraparound Childcare
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will invest £300 million to ensure all parents can access wraparound childcare before and after school by September 2026.

source.quote: And to give working parents more flexibility, we are investing £300 million so that all parents can access wraparound childcare before and after school by September 2026.

policies.policy_title: Deliver Family Hub in Every Local Authority
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will go further to deliver a Family Hub in every local authority in England, supporting families from early years through to adulthood with a range of services.

source.quote: Our plan has already delivered Family Hubs in over 75 local authorities. We will go further to deliver a Family Hub in every local authority in England.

policies.policy_title: Improve Children's Social Care
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will improve the experiences of children in social care by creating more places in children’s homes, prioritising kinship care, supporting adoptive families, and assisting care leavers with housing, education, and employment.

source.quote: We will improve the experiences of children in social care, because every child deserves to live in a safe and loving home. We will create more places in children’s homes while prioritising keeping families together where that’s best for the child through our Kinship Care Strategy and helping children grow up in loving adoptive families where that is a better option.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Parental Controls for Social Media
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will urgently consult on introducing further parental controls over children's access to social media, including effective age verification and necessary technology, building on the Online Safety Act.

source.quote: We will urgently consult on introducing further parental controls over access to social media. We know this is a complex area and we need more effective age verification and parental controls.

policies.policy_title: Reform Disability Benefits and Capability for Work Assessments
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will reform disability benefits for better targeting and mental health provision, improve PIP assessments, and tighten how the benefits system assesses capability for work from September 2025 to provide tailored support for those with moderate conditions to engage with work.

source.quote: Reform our disability benefits so they are better targeted and reflect people’s genuine needs... Tighten up how the benefits system assesses capability for work. ...We will change the assessments from September 2025 so that those with more moderate mental health issues or mobility problems who could potentially engage with the world of work are given tailored support...

policies.policy_title: Overhaul Fit Note Process
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will overhaul the fit note process, moving responsibility for issuing fit notes from GPs to specialist work and health professionals, and integrating this with the WorkWell service to help people stay in or return to work.

source.quote: Overhaul the fit note process so that people are not being signed off sick as a default. ...We will design a new system which moves the responsibility for issuing fit notes away from our hard-pressed GPs towards specialist work and health professionals...

policies.policy_title: Introduce Tougher Welfare Sanctions
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce tougher sanctions rules, bringing forward the claimant review point for the long-term unemployed to 12 months, and closing cases with benefit removal for those who refuse suitable jobs or mandatory work placements.

source.quote: Introduce tougher sanctions rules so people who refuse to take up suitable jobs after 12 months on benefits can have their cases closed and their benefits removed entirely. We will bring forward the new claimant review point for the long-term unemployed from 18 months to 12 months.

policies.policy_title: Accelerate Universal Credit Rollout and Combat Fraud
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will accelerate the rollout of Universal Credit to all remaining legacy benefit claimants to ensure work always pays, and will clamp down on welfare fraud with a new Fraud Bill giving DWP powers similar to HMRC to identify, investigate, and pursue fraudsters.

source.quote: Accelerate the rollout of Universal Credit to ensure it always pays to work. We will move all of those remaining on outdated legacy benefits onto Universal Credit... Continue to clamp down on fraudsters. ...This will include a new Fraud Bill to give DWP powers similar to that of HMRC...

policies.policy_title: Reform Child Maintenance Service
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will reform the Child Maintenance Service to prevent non-compliance and introduce new laws to crack down on non-payment, while also improving support for victims of domestic or economic abuse.

source.quote: We will reform the Child Maintenance Service to prevent noncompliance and new laws to help crack down on non-payment. We’ll also look at how the Service can better support victims of domestic or economic abuse...

policies.policy_title: Legislate for Register of Children Not in School
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will legislate to create a register of children not in school to ensure all children receive a high-quality education, including those who are home-schooled.

source.quote: And to ensure all children are getting a high-quality education, including those who are home schooled, we will legislate to create a register of children not in school.

policies.policy_title: Strengthen Parental Rights in School Curriculum
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will deliver new legislation to make clear that parents have a right to see what their child is being taught in school and that schools must share all materials, especially on sensitive matters like relationships and sex education, and guarantee gender identity is not taught to children.

source.quote: We will work to strengthen the relationship between schools and parents, including by delivering new legislation which will make clear, beyond all doubt, that parents have a right to see what their child is being taught in school and schools must share all materials, especially on sensitive matters like relationships and sex education. ...and guarantee the contested concept of gender identity is not taught to children.

policies.policy_title: Increase Faith School Places
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will lift the cap on faith schools, allowing them to offer more places to children based on faith and encouraging their expansion.

source.quote: We will lift the cap on faith schools, allowing them to offer more places to children based on faith and encouraging them to expand.

policies.policy_title: Transform Education for SEND Children
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will transform education for children with special educational needs, delivering 60,000 more school places and 15 new free schools, and backing independent special schools.

source.quote: We will transform education for children with special educational needs, ending the postcode lottery of support by delivering 60,000 more school places and a further 15 new free schools for children with special educational needs.

policies.policy_title: Pass Veterans' Bill
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will pass the UK's first ever Veterans' Bill to enshrine Veterans' rights in law, ensuring qualifications from service are recognized in civilian life, creating a legal duty on government to look after veterans, and widening the scope of the Armed Forces Covenant.

source.quote: We will pass the UK’s first ever Veterans’ Bill to enshrine Veterans’ rights in law. Ensuring qualifications from Service are correctly recognised in civilian life, creating a legal duty on government to look after our Veterans and widening the scope of the Armed Forces Covenant in law to include the UK Government and devolved administrations.

policies.policy_title: Reform Asylum Treaties
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will work with other countries to reform international asylum laws to make them fit for an age of mass migration, restricting visa access from countries that do not cooperate on national priorities like illegal migration.

source.quote: Reform asylum rules, holding an international summit and working with other countries to reform international laws to make them fit for an age of mass migration. We will restrict visa access from countries that don’t work with us on our national priorities, like illegal migration.

policies.policy_title: Return People with No Right to Be Here
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will sign further returns deals, like the one agreed with Albania, to return people with no right to be in the UK to their own countries.

source.quote: Return people with no right to be here to their own country. We will sign further returns deals like the one we have already agreed with Albania.

policies.policy_title: Control Safe and Legal Routes for Refugees
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will give Parliament control over the number of places offered on safe and legal routes for refugees, with a cap based on the capacity of local areas.

source.quote: With control of our borders, we can do more to help refugees fleeing persecution. ...we will give parliament control of how many places we offer on safe and legal routes to support those in genuine need from around the world, with a cap based on the capacity of local areas.

policies.policy_title: Raise Skilled Worker and Family Visa Income Thresholds with Inflation
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will automatically raise the Skilled Worker visa salary threshold and the Family visa minimum income requirement with inflation to ensure they do not undercut UK workers.

source.quote: Going forward, we will raise the Skilled Worker threshold and Family income requirement with inflation automatically to make sure they don’t undercut UK workers.

policies.policy_title: Require Migrants to Undergo Health Checks and Pay Higher Surcharge/Insurance
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will require migrants to undergo health checks prior to travel and increase their Immigration Health Surcharge or mandate health insurance if they are likely to burden the NHS, and will remove student discounts on the surcharge.

source.quote: We will go further, in line with other countries, by requiring migrants to undergo a health check in advance of travel and increasing their Immigration Health Surcharge or requiring them to buy health insurance if they are likely to be a burden on the NHS. We will increase all visa fees and remove the student discount to the Immigration Health Surcharge to raise more money for public services.

policies.policy_title: Implement Planned Social Care Reforms and Multi-Year Funding
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will implement planned reforms to cap social care costs from October 2025, provide local authorities with a multi-year funding settlement for social care at the next Spending Review, and take forward reforms from the 'People at the Heart of Care' White Paper.

source.quote: We will implement our planned reforms to cap social care costs from October 2025. We will invest in more and better facilities, continuing to deliver 40 new hospitals by 2030 and investing proportionately more in out-of-hospital services over time. ...At the next Spending Review, we will give local authorities a multi-year funding settlement to support social care and will take forward the reforms in our ‘People at the Heart of Care’ White Paper.

policies.policy_title: Improve NHS Dental Access and Sustainabilit
policies.stated: The Conservative Party's Dental Recovery Plan will unlock 2.5 million more NHS dental appointments through a patient premium, reform the dental contract, require newly qualified dentists to work in the NHS or repay training costs, and promote oral health through 'Smile for Life' and 'golden hellos' for rural dentists.

source.quote: Our Dental Recovery Plan will unlock 2.5 million more NHS dental appointments, through a patient premium to encourage dentists to take on new NHS patients. We will make further reforms to the dental contract to ensure its future sustainability and we will ensure newly qualified dentists have to work in the NHS for a number of years or pay back their training costs.

policies.policy_title: Invest £3.4 Billion in NHS Technology and Productivity
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will invest £3.4 billion in new technology to transform the NHS, making the NHS App the single front door for services, using AI to free up staff time, replacing outdated computers, digitising processes with the Federated Data Platform, and funding technology for faster scan analysis.

source.quote: We will invest £3.4 billion in new technology to transform the NHS for staff and for patients. The NHS Productivity Plan will see NHS productivity grow by 1.9% a year from 2025-26 – unlocking £35 billion of cumulative savings by the end of the decade.

policies.policy_title: Publish and Implement Major Conditions Strategy
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will publish and implement a Major Conditions Strategy to prevent and improve care for six major health conditions (cancer, heart disease, musculoskeletal disorders, mental ill-health, dementia, and respiratory disease).

source.quote: We will publish and implement a Major Conditions Strategy to prevent these conditions from occurring and ensure those living with them receive the best possible care.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Tobacco and Vapes Bill
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will bring forward a landmark Tobacco and Vapes Bill in their first King's Speech to restrict advertising of products high in fat, salt, and sugar, and gather evidence on ultra-processed food.

source.quote: We will bring forward our landmark Tobacco and Vapes Bill in our first King’s Speech. We will continue to tackle childhood and adult obesity and will legislate to restrict the advertising of products high in fat, salt and sugar.

policies.policy_title: Prioritise Women's Health
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will prioritise women's health by bringing forward a national strategy for maternity care, delivering additional funding for maternal safety, improving access to mental health and perinatal pelvic health services, expanding women's health hubs, and rolling out fracture liaison services.

source.quote: We will prioritise women’s health, following publication of the first ever Women’s Health Strategy in 2022. To support women further, we will: Bring forward a comprehensive national strategy for maternity care... Deliver additional funding for maternal safety and improve access to mental health services for new mums... Expand women’s health hubs... Roll out fracture liaison services...

policies.policy_title: Implement Cass Review Recommendations on Gender Care
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will complete the implementation of the Cass Review, protecting young people questioning their gender from ideologically-driven care, ensuring NHS services follow evidence-based practices, and legislating to permanently prevent private prescription and supply of puberty blockers.

source.quote: We will complete the implementation of the Cass Review, protecting young people questioning their gender from ideologically-driven care and ensuring that NHS services follow evidence-based best practice. We have already stopped the routine use by the NHS of puberty blockers for gender dysphoria and will legislate to permanently prevent their private prescription and supply.

policies.policy_title: Amend NHS Constitution for Single-Sex Accommodation and Same-Sex Care
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will amend the NHS Constitution to recognise every patient’s right to request single-sex accommodation and same-sex intimate care, and will ensure words like 'breastfeeding' and 'mother' are not replaced.

source.quote: We will amend the NHS Constitution so that it recognises every patient’s right to request single-sex accommodation and same-sex intimate care. We will not allow the word ‘woman’ to be erased by health services. Words such as ‘breastfeeding’ and ‘mother’ will not be replaced by ‘chestfeeding’ and ‘birthing parent’.

policies.policy_title: Expand Mental Health Support Services
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will expand mental health support by extending Mental Health Support Teams to 100% of schools and colleges by 2030, opening early support hubs for ages 11-25 in every community by 2030, increasing NHS Talking Therapies by 50%, and boosting Individual Placement and Support capacity by 140,000 places.

source.quote: Expand coverage of Mental Health Support Teams from 50% to 100% of schools and colleges in England by 2030. Open early support hubs for those aged 11-25 in every local community by 2030. Increase the planned expansion of NHS Talking Therapies by 50%... Boost the capacity of Individual Placement and Support for Severe Mental Illness by 140,000 places.

policies.policy_title: Pass New Mental Health Law
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will pass a new law in the first session of the next Parliament to provide better treatment and support for severe mental health needs.

source.quote: Pass a new law to provide better treatment and support for severe mental health needs in the first session of the next Parliament.

policies.policy_title: Pay Infected Blood Compensation
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will pay comprehensive compensation to those infected and affected by the infected blood scandal, accepting inquiry principles and providing a further £210,000 interim payment to living infected beneficiaries.

source.quote: We will pay comprehensive compensation to those infected and those affected by this scandal, accepting the principles recommended by the Inquiry. Whatever it costs to deliver the scheme, we will pay it. We will also give a further £210,000 interim payment to living infected beneficiaries...

policies.policy_title: Give Police New Powers and Tools
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will back the police by giving officers new powers and tools to catch criminals, including technology like facial recognition and powers to seize knives and track down stolen property, while supporting lawful use of force.

source.quote: Back the police, by giving officers new powers and tools to catch criminals, including technology like facial recognition and powers to seize knives and track down stolen property. We will always back the police in the lawful and professional use of force, alongside a fair and proportionate accountability system.

policies.policy_title: Restore Public Trust in Policing
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will restore public trust in policing by licensing officers for specialist roles, legislating for appropriate vetting during service, and ensuring officers who fail can be sacked.

source.quote: Restore public trust in policing. We will license police officers for specialist roles, as we do already for firearms officers. We will legislate to ensure officers are appropriately vetted during their service and those who fail can be sacked.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Martyn's Law
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will urgently introduce Martyn’s Law to ensure premises are better prepared for terrorist attacks by requiring them to take proportionate steps to mitigate risks.

source.quote: We will urgently introduce Martyn’s Law, in tribute to Martyn Hett, who was tragically killed alongside 21 others in the Manchester Arena terrorist attack in 2017. This will ensure premises are better prepared for terrorist attacks by requiring them to take proportionate steps to mitigate risks.

policies.policy_title: Toughen Community Sentencing
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will toughen community sentencing by increasing the use of community payback and electronic tagging, ensuring criminals repay their debt to society and communities see justice served.

source.quote: We will toughen up community sentencing by increasing the use of community payback and electronic tagging, so criminals pay their debt to society and communities witness justice being served.

policies.policy_title: Combat Fraud
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will keep turning the tide against fraudsters by banning SIM farms and cold calls on financial products, building on the work of the National Fraud Squad.

source.quote: We will ban SIM farms, which are used to send bulk messages for fraudulent texts, and ban cold calls on financial products so fraudsters cannot dupe people into buying fake investments.

policies.policy_title: Legislate New Offences for Violence Against Women and Girls
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will legislate to create new offences for spiking, the creation of sexualised deepfake images, and taking intimate images without consent, alongside strengthening existing laws against stalking, coercive behaviour, and revenge porn.

source.quote: We will legislate to create new offences for spiking, the creation of sexualised deepfake images and taking intimate images without consent. We have strengthened the law to punish predators with new offences for stalking, controlling or coercive behaviour, non-fatal strangulation and suffocation, sharing of intimate images or ‘revenge porn’, non-consensual taking of images of a woman breastfeeding, ‘up skirting’ and raised the maximum penalties for harassment.

policies.policy_title: Toughen Sentencing for Domestic Murders and 'Rough Sex' Defence
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will toughen sentencing for murders within the context of domestic abuse with new aggravating factors and introduce a 25-year prison term, regardless of weapon use. They will also introduce an aggravating factor for murders in the context of 'rough sex' to prevent it being used as an excuse for lighter sentences.

source.quote: We will toughen sentencing for murders that take place within the context of domestic abuse with new aggravating factors, such as if they involve coercive and controlling behaviour or gratuitous attacks. We will introduce a 25-year prison term for domestic murders, regardless of whether a weapon is used. ...We will introduce an aggravating factor for murders that happen in the context of ‘rough sex’, so it is never used as an excuse to get a lighter sentence.

policies.policy_title: Improve Justice and Support for Rape Victims
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will ensure rape victims receive justice and support with a new investigatory model for police and prosecutors and pre-recorded cross-examination for victims in all Crown courts.

source.quote: We will ensure rape victims get the justice and support they deserve, with a new investigatory model for rape for police forces and prosecutors and pre-recorded cross-examination for victims in all Crown courts.

policies.policy_title: Toughen Sentencing for Worst Offenders
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will toughen sentencing for the worst offenders, making life imprisonment without parole mandatory for more heinous murderers and requiring rapists and serious sexual offenders to serve their full sentences in prison. They will also toughen sentences for knife crime, grooming gangs, and assaults against retail workers.

source.quote: We will toughen sentencing for the worst offenders. We have already ended Labour’s automatic halfway release for violent and serious sexual offenders. We will make life imprisonment without parole mandatory for more of the most heinous murderers and require rapists and other serious sexual offenders to spend the whole of their sentences behind bars.

policies.policy_title: Build Four New Prisons and Expand Removals
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will build four new prisons, completing the programme of 20,000 new prison places by 2030, by scrapping legacy EU rules and streamlining the planning system. They will also remove more Foreign National Offenders by increasing removals under the Early Removal Scheme and negotiating more Prisoner Transfer Agreements.

source.quote: We will build four new prisons, completing our programme of 20,000 new prison places by 2030. ...We will remove more Foreign National Offenders by increasing removals under the Early Removal Scheme and negotiating more Prisoner Transfer Agreements.

policies.policy_title: Cut Covid Court Backlog
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will cut the Covid court backlog by keeping open Nightingale courtrooms, funding sitting days, investing in court maintenance, and continuing to digitise court processes and expand remote hearings.

source.quote: We will cut the Covid court backlog by keeping open Nightingale courtrooms, funding sitting days and investing in court maintenance. And we will continue to digitise court processes and expand the use of remote hearings.

policies.policy_title: Expand Legal Aid and Pupillages
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will match fund 100 criminal law pupillages to speed up justice for victims and will continue to ensure access to justice through legal aid provision, also expanding legal aid at inquests related to major incidents.

source.quote: We will match fund 100 criminal law pupillages to speed up justice for victims and will continue to ensure access to justice through legal aid provision. We will expand the provision of legal aid at inquests related to major incidents...

policies.policy_title: Design Redress Scheme for Child Sexual Abuse Victims
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will design a redress scheme for victims of child sexual abuse in institutional settings, including grooming gang victims, and make a national apology to grooming gang victims.

source.quote: We will design a redress scheme for the victims of child sexual abuse in institutional settings that reflects their needs. We will ensure this includes the victims of grooming gangs and make a national apology to grooming gang victims.

policies.policy_title: Restrict Sex Offenders from Changing Names
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will ensure sex offenders cannot evade justice or conceal their identity by restricting them from changing their names.

source.quote: We will ensure sex offenders cannot evade justice or conceal their identity by restricting sex offenders from changing their names.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Further Powers to Curb Disruptive Protests
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce further powers to ban face coverings, pyrotechnics, and climbing on war memorials during protests. They will also strengthen police powers to prevent protests that pose a risk of serious disorder by considering cumulative impact and banning protests outside schools.

source.quote: We will introduce further powers to ban face coverings, pyrotechnics and climbing on war memorials. We will strengthen police powers to prevent protests or marches that pose a risk of serious disorder, by allowing police to take into account the cumulative impact of protests. We will ban protests outside schools to stop mobs from intimidating teachers and children.

policies.policy_title: Legislate for Annual Oil and Gas Licensing Rounds
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will legislate to ensure annual licensing rounds for oil and gas production from the North Sea to provide energy, protect jobs, and reduce reliance on foreign powers, while keeping the windfall tax in place until 2028-29 or until prices normalize.

source.quote: We will legislate to ensure annual licensing rounds for oil and gas production from our own North Sea to provide energy to homes and businesses across the country and protect high-skilled and well-paid jobs in the industry.

policies.policy_title: Treble Offshore Wind Capacity
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will treble the UK's offshore wind capacity to deliver low-cost, home-grown energy and support industrial clusters in regions like the North East of England, Scotland, and Wales.

source.quote: Treble our offshore wind capacity, to deliver low-cost, home-grown energy and support the development of vibrant industrial clusters in places like the North East of England, Scotland and Wales.

policies.policy_title: Build Two Carbon Capture and Storage Clusters
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will build the first two carbon capture and storage clusters across North Wales, the North West of England, Teesside, and the Humber, creating jobs and cutting carbon, while progressing a second tranche of projects.

source.quote: Build the first two carbon capture and storage clusters, based across North Wales and, the North West of England and Teesside and the Humber, cutting carbon and creating tens of thousands of jobs in these regions, and progress the second tranche of projects in Aberdeenshire and the Humber.

policies.policy_title: Invest £1.1 Billion in Green Industries Growth Accelerator
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will invest £1.1 billion into the Green Industries Growth Accelerator to support British manufacturing capabilities, boost supply chains, and ensure the energy transition is made in Britain.

source.quote: Invest £1.1 billion into the Green Industries Growth Accelerator to support British manufacturing capabilities, boost supply chains and ensure our energy transition is made in Britain.

policies.policy_title: Scale Up Nuclear Power with Small Modular Reactors
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will scale up nuclear power by approving two new fleets of Small Modular Reactors within the first 100 days of the next Parliament, aiming to rapidly expand nuclear power, create jobs, and deliver cheaper, cleaner energy by halving approval times.

source.quote: Scale up nuclear power, building on our work establishing Great British Nuclear. Within the first 100 days of the next Parliament, we will approve two new fleets of Small Modular Reactors to rapidly expand nuclear power, create well-paid, high-skilled jobs and deliver cheaper, cleaner and more secure energy.

policies.policy_title: Deliver New Gigawatt Power Plant at Wylfa
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will deliver a new gigawatt power plant at Wylfa in North Wales and work with industry to deliver existing projects at Hinkley Point and Sizewell.

source.quote: Deliver a new gigawatt power plant at Wylfa in North Wales and work with industry to deliver existing projects at Hinkley Point and Sizewell.

policies.policy_title: Implement Import Carbon Pricing Mechanism
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will implement a new import carbon pricing mechanism by 2027 to ensure that imports of carbon-intensive goods from countries with lower or no carbon prices face a comparable carbon price to UK-produced goods, reducing carbon leakage.

source.quote: We will implement a new import carbon pricing mechanism by 2027 to ensure that imports of iron, steel, aluminium, ceramics and cement from countries with a lower or no carbon price will face a comparable carbon price to those goods produced in the UK.

policies.policy_title: Cut Cost of Net Zero for Consumers
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will cut the cost of net zero for consumers by guaranteeing no new green levies or charges, ensuring annual policy costs on energy bills are lower than in 2023, and reforming the Climate Change Committee to consider cost to households and energy security.

source.quote: Cut the cost of net zero for consumers by taking a more pragmatic approach, guaranteeing no new green levies or charges while accelerating the rollout of renewables. ...Ensuring that green levies on household bills are lower. ...Reforming the Climate Change Committee, giving it an explicit mandate to consider cost to households and UK energy security in its future climate advice.

policies.policy_title: Maintain Energy Price Cap and Reform Standing Charges
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will maintain the energy price cap to protect households from overcharging and will review and reform standing charges to keep them as low as possible.

source.quote: Maintaining our energy price cap, protecting millions of households from being overcharged by their supplier. ...Reviewing and reforming standing charges to keep them as low as possible.

policies.policy_title: Invest £6 Billion in Energy Efficiency and Voucher Scheme
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will invest £6 billion in energy efficiency over the next three years to make around a million homes warmer and will fund an energy efficiency voucher scheme, open to all households, to support installations like solar panels.

source.quote: We will invest £6 billion in energy efficiency over the next three years to make around a million homes warmer. And we will fund an energy efficiency voucher scheme, open to every household in England, to support the installation of energy efficiency measures and solar panels, helping families lower their bills.

policies.policy_title: Ensure Democratic Consent for Onshore Wind and Protect Agricultural Land from Solar
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will ensure democratic consent for onshore wind, ensuring local areas that host it directly benefit through measures like energy bill discounts. They will support solar in appropriate places, not on prime agricultural land, and prevent clustering of multiple solar farms.

source.quote: We will ensure democratic consent for onshore wind, striking the right balance between energy security and the views of their local communities. ...We will support solar in the right places, not on our best agricultural land.

policies.policy_title: Improve Social Housing Allocation and Management
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will legislate for new 'Local Connection' and 'UK Connection' tests for social housing in England to ensure fair allocation. They will also implement a 'three strikes and you’re out' expectation for social housing landlords to evict tenants guilty of anti-social behaviour.

source.quote: We will legislate for new ‘Local Connection’ and ‘UK Connection’ tests for social housing in England, to ensure this valuable but limited resource is allocated fairly. And we will implement a ‘three strikes and you’re out’ expectation of social housing landlords for anti-social behaviour.

policies.policy_title: Pledge Not to Increase Family Home Taxes
policies.stated: Under the Family Home Tax Guarantee, the Conservative Party pledges not to increase the number of council tax bands, undertake an expensive council tax revaluation, cut council tax discounts, or increase the rate or level of Stamp Duty, and will maintain Private Residence Relief.

source.quote: Under the Family Home Tax Guarantee, we will not increase the number of council tax bands, undertake an expensive council tax revaluation or cut council tax discounts... We will maintain Private Residence Relief so that people’s homes are protected from Capital Gains Tax and we will not increase the rate or level of Stamp Duty to support homeowners.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Capital Gains Tax Relief for Landlords Selling to Tenants
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce a two-year temporary Capital Gains Tax relief for landlords who sell their properties to their existing tenants.

source.quote: To further support homeowners, we will introduce a two-year temporary Capital Gains Tax relief for landlords who sell to their existing tenants.

policies.policy_title: Protect Right to Buy Discounts
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will protect the laws ensuring Right to Buy discounts rise with inflation and fight any plans by local authorities to abolish Right to Buy.

source.quote: We will protect the laws that ensure the discounts rise with inflation and fight any plan by local authorities to abolish the Right to Buy altogether.

policies.policy_title: Complete Leasehold Reform
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will complete the process of leasehold reform, capping ground rents at £250 (reducing to peppercorn over time), ending misuse of forfeiture, and making commonhold easier to adopt.

source.quote: We will complete the process of leasehold reform, to improve the lives of over four million leaseholders. We will cap ground rents at £250, reducing them to peppercorn over time. We will end the misuse of forfeiture so leaseholders don’t lose their property and capital unfairly and make it easier to take up commonhold.

policies.policy_title: Pass Renters Reform Bill
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will pass a Renters Reform Bill to deliver fairness in the rental market, fully abolishing Section 21 evictions while strengthening other grounds for landlords to evict private tenants guilty of anti-social behaviour.

source.quote: We will pass a Renters Reform Bill that will deliver fairness in the rental market for landlords and renters alike. We will deliver the court reforms necessary to fully abolish Section 21 and strengthen other grounds for landlords to evict private tenants guilty of anti-social behaviour.

policies.policy_title: Continue to End Rough Sleeping
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will continue with plans to end rough sleeping and prevent people from ending up on the streets, including delivering commitments under the Local Authority Housing Fund and reviewing temporary accommodation quality.

source.quote: We will continue with our plans to end rough sleeping and prevent people from ending up on the streets in the first place, after making significant progress over the last few years. We will deliver our commitments under the Local Authority Housing Fund and review the quality of temporary accommodation.

policies.policy_title: Require Developer-Funded Cladding Remediation
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will continue support for leaseholders affected by historic building safety problems by requiring the continuation of developer-funded remediation programmes for mid- and high-rise buildings.

source.quote: After delivering landmark new laws that freed leaseholders from cladding bills following on from the awful tragedy of Grenfell Tower, we will continue our support for leaseholders affected by historic building safety problems by requiring the continuation of developer-funded remediation programmes for mid- and high-rise buildings.

policies.policy_title: Manage Growth of Holiday Lets
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will ensure councils have the powers needed to manage the uncontrolled growth of holiday lets, which can cause nuisance to local residents and 'hollowing out' of communities.

source.quote: We will ensure councils have the powers they need to manage the uncontrolled growth of holiday lets, which can cause nuisance to local residents and a hollowing out of communities.

policies.policy_title: Provide 105 Towns with £20 Million Endowment Funds
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will provide 105 towns across the UK with a £20 million endowment fund for local people to invest in their town's future, including reviving high streets or bringing new housing to town centres.

source.quote: Provide 105 towns in the UK with a £20 million endowment fund for local people to change their town’s future. This includes extending our plan to 30 more towns who will benefit from funding that they can use on their priorities such as reviving high streets or bringing new housing to town centres.

policies.policy_title: Extend Community Ownership Fund
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will extend its Community Ownership Fund to help more communities across the UK take control of vital local assets like pubs, music venues, libraries, green spaces, and leisure centres.

source.quote: Extend our Community Ownership Fund to help more communities across the UK take control of vital community assets like pubs, music venues, libraries, green spaces, leisure centres and more.

policies.policy_title: Extend UK Shared Prosperity Fund
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will extend the UK Shared Prosperity Fund for three years at the next Spending Review, before using this funding to support UK-wide National Service, focusing on increasing life chances, civic pride, and skills.

source.quote: Extend the UK Shared Prosperity Fund for three years at the next Spending Review, before using this funding to support UK-wide National Service. Both schemes will involve funding community groups focused on increasing life chances, instilling civic pride and boosting people’s skills.

policies.policy_title: Create More Freeports and Business Rates Retention Zones
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will create more Freeports and enable councils to retain all business rates growth within defined zones for 25 years to finance new infrastructure and invest in local industries.

source.quote: Create more Freeports and Business Rates Retention zones. Freeports have already generated just under £3 billion in investment, which in turn will create thousands of jobs. ...We will enable councils to retain all business rates growth within a defined zone for 25 years...

policies.policy_title: Invest in Investment Zones
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will continue backing Investment Zones across the country, giving areas £160 million to catalyse local growth and investment.

source.quote: Continue backing Investment Zones across the country, giving areas £160 million to catalyse local growth and investment.

policies.policy_title: Revitalise High Streets and Tackle Street Scars/Fly Tipping
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will revitalise high streets by changing planning laws to support local market days and regenerate shopping centres. They will also make industry pay for removing chewing-gum, raise fines for utility firms' 'street scars', and make fly tipping an offence carrying penalty points against driving licences.

source.quote: Give our high streets a new lease of life and restore pride in place. We will change planning laws to support places to bring back local market days and regenerate defunct shopping centres. ...We will make fly tipping an offence that carries penalty points against your driving licence.

policies.policy_title: Extend £2 Bus Fare Cap
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will extend the £2 bus fare cap in England for the entirety of the next Parliament, benefitting young people and low-income households, funded by savings from railway reform.

source.quote: We will extend the £2 bus fare cap in England for the entirety of the next Parliament, benefitting young people and low-income households while pensioners continue to benefit from the free bus pass. The extension of the £2 fare cap will be funded by savings from reform of the railway which will save up to £1.5 billion annually.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Rail Reform Bill to Create Great British Railways
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce a Rail Reform Bill in their first King’s Speech to create Great British Railways (GBR), headquartered in Derby, to deliver a revitalised private-public partnership, reliable services, simpler tickets, and growing the role of the private sector.

source.quote: We will introduce a Rail Reform Bill in our first King’s Speech to create Great British Railways (GBR), headquartered in Derby. GBR will usher in a revitalised private-public partnership, delivering a modern and innovative railway with reliable services, and simpler tickets.

policies.policy_title: Roll Out Mobile Pay-As-You-Go Contactless Tickets Nationwide
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will roll out mobile pay-as-you-go contactless tickets nationwide for rail services over the next Parliament.

source.quote: Over the next Parliament, we will also roll out mobile pay as you go contactless tickets nationwide, bringing rail into line with how we pay for many goods and services.

policies.policy_title: Improve Safety for Active Travel
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will work with Active Travel England to make it safer for people to walk or cycle, including safe routes to schools and measures to protect pedestrians, cyclists, and vulnerable road users, ensuring new schemes have local support first.

source.quote: We will work with Active Travel England to make it safer for people to walk or cycle, including projects like ensuring safe walking routes to schools and measures to protect pedestrians, cyclists and other vulnerable road users. Where new schemes are introduced, we will ensure they have local support first.

policies.policy_title: Align Penalties for Dangerous Cyclists
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will bring penalties for dangerous cyclists who kill or injure into line with those for other road users.

source.quote: While we back responsible cyclists, we will bring penalties for the rare instances where dangerous cyclists kill or injure into line with those for other road users.

policies.policy_title: Maintain Six-Day Royal Mail Postal Service
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will ensure Royal Mail continues to deliver the universal postal service, maintaining a six-day delivery service that is affordable for customers and efficient.

source.quote: We will ensure Royal Mail continues to deliver the universal postal service in a way which is affordable for customers as well as being efficient and financially sustainable. Saturday deliveries are important, particularly to businesses, which is why we are clear they will not be scrapped. Conservatives are clear we want a continued six-day service...

policies.policy_title: Ensure Post Office Horizon Scandal Redress
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will ensure the new redress scheme for victims of the Post Office Horizon scandal is in place and ready to make payments to claimants by the end of July.

source.quote: We have taken exceptional and unprecedented action, legislating to quash the convictions of those affected by the Post Office Horizon scandal... We will ensure the new redress scheme is in place and ready to make payments to claimants by the end of July.

policies.policy_title: Ensure Access to Cash and Banking Hubs
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will continue to ensure appropriate access to cash in local communities by requiring banks and building societies to consider customer needs when closing branches, building on the establishment of over 100 Banking Hubs.

source.quote: We have legislated to require banks and building societies considering closing a branch to consider the needs of all their customers and ensure they continue to have appropriate access to cash in their local community. We have already announced over 100 Banking Hubs...

policies.policy_title: Ensure Schools Follow Guidance for Gender Questioning Students
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will pass legislation to ensure schools must follow guidance for teachers on supporting gender questioning students, clarifying parents' right to know if their child wants to be treated as the opposite sex and involving them in decisions.

source.quote: In recent years, an increasing number of children have started questioning their gender, the consequences of which are still unknown. This is why we will pass legislation to ensure schools must follow our guidance for teachers on how best to support gender questioning students in schools and colleges. Parents will have a right to know if their child wants to be treated as the opposite sex and schools will have to involve parents when it comes to decisions about their children.

policies.policy_title: Improve Support for Guide/Assistance Dogs
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will improve support for people who have guide or assistance dogs in the next Parliament.

source.quote: In the next Parliament we will improve support for people who have guide or assistance dogs and explore bidding to host and deliver the 2031 Special Olympics World Summer Games.

policies.policy_title: Ratify Global Oceans Treaty and Continue Deep Sea Mining Moratorium
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will ratify the Global Oceans Treaty early in the next Parliament and continue with its moratorium on deep sea mining.

source.quote: We will continue with our moratorium on deep sea mining and will ratify the Global Oceans Treaty early in the next Parliament.

policies.policy_title: Maintain Record Flood Defence Funding
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will maintain record flooding funding of £5.6 billion over 2021-2027 to continue protecting homes, farms, and businesses, alongside the Flood Recovery Framework and Farming Recovery Fund.

source.quote: We will maintain this record flooding funding to continue to protect homes, farms and businesses. This will work alongside the Flood Recovery Framework and Farming Recovery Fund to directly support communities, businesses and farmers affected by flooding.

policies.policy_title: Hold Water Companies Accountable and Invest Fines
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will work with the regulator to further hold water companies to account, including banning executive bonuses for serious criminal breaches, and will invest fines from water companies into river restoration projects.

source.quote: Working with the regulator to further hold companies to account, including banning executive bonuses if a company has committed a serious criminal breach. This will build on our legislation for unlimited fines. ...Using fines from water companies to invest in river restoration projects...

policies.policy_title: Reform Water Company Price Review Process
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will reform the 'Price Review' regulatory process for water companies to move towards a more localised, catchment-based, and outcome-focused approach, strengthening sanctions for companies that fail to deliver.

source.quote: To deliver our ambitious plan for water beyond 2030, we will reform the ‘Price Review’ regulatory process for water companies. This will consider how we move to a more localised catchment-based and outcome-focussed approach, that better utilises nature-based solutions and further strengthens sanctions for water companies that fail to deliver for the public, coasts and rivers.

policies.policy_title: Deliver Tree Planting and Peatland Commitments
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will deliver its tree planting and peatland commitments through Nature for Climate funding, unlock private investment, and cut red tape in the planning system for tree planting.

source.quote: Deliver our tree planting and peatland commitments through our Nature for Climate funding, and continuing our work to unlock private investment. ...Cut red tape that holds back the planting of trees in the planning system.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Forest Risk Commodities Legislation
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce forest risk commodities legislation early in the next Parliament to tackle the UK's impact on illegal deforestation internationally.

source.quote: Deliver our commitment at COP28 to introduce forest risk commodities legislation early in the next Parliament, tackling our impact on illegal deforestation internationally.

policies.policy_title: Designate 11th National Park and Improve Access to Nature
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will designate its 11th National Park, invest to improve existing National Parks, use Landscape Recovery Schemes for local projects, and support programmes encouraging disadvantaged children to access green spaces.

source.quote: Designate our 11th National Park alongside investing to improve existing National Parks and protected landscapes. ...Use future rounds of our Landscape Recovery Scheme to support more local projects... Continue to support programmes that encourage disadvantaged children and young people to access green spaces.

policies.policy_title: Crack Down on Organised Waste Crime and Fly Tipping
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will take comprehensive action to crack down on organised waste crime, especially those impacting protected nature sites, and deliver enhanced penalties for fly tipping.

source.quote: We will take comprehensive action to crack down on organised waste crime, especially those who impact protected nature sites. We will deliver our enhanced penalties for fly tipping, giving councils new tools to help tackle offenders.

policies.policy_title: Develop UK-Wide Deposit Return Scheme
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will continue to develop a UK-wide Deposit Return Scheme, while working to minimise its impact on businesses and consumers.

source.quote: We will continue to develop a UK-wide Deposit Return Scheme, while working to minimise the impact on businesses and consumers.

policies.policy_title: Prevent New Waste Incinerators
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will prevent new waste incinerators from being built, including those with recent permit approvals where substantial construction has not taken place, recognising the impact on local communities and increased recycling rates.

source.quote: We will prevent new waste incinerators being built, including those with recent permit approvals, revoking those where substantial construction has not taken place. This recognises the impact on local communities and that increased recycling rates will reduce the need for incineration capacity in the longer term.

policies.policy_title: Maintain Grassroots Sports Facilities Investment
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will maintain the pace of investment in grassroots sports facilities over the next Parliament through the continuation of the Multi-Sport Grassroots Facilities Programme, expanding criteria to benefit more sports.

source.quote: We will maintain this pace of investment over the next Parliament through the continuation of the Multi-Sport Grassroots Facilities Programme. We will look to expand the criteria to ensure more sports benefit from this investment.

policies.policy_title: Introduce Laws for Independent Football Regulator
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce laws to ensure fans never face the threat of clubs joining breakaway competitions and to give them more voice through the Independent Football Regulator.

source.quote: We will introduce laws to ensure our fans never again face the threat of clubs in England joining breakaway closed-shop competitions and giving them more of a voice through the Independent Football Regulator.

policies.policy_title: Prioritise Equal Access for Women and Girls in Grassroots Sport
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will prioritise equal access for women and girls in its ongoing program of investment in grassroots sports facilities.

source.quote: We will prioritise equal access for women and girls in our ongoing programme of investment in grassroots sports facilities.

policies.policy_title: Launch Review of Nighttime Economy in England
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will launch a review of the nighttime economy in England, looking at how to reverse the decline in pubs and clubs and make towns and cities better places to go out.

source.quote: We will turn this around by launching a review of the nighttime economy in England, looking at how to reverse the decline in pubs and clubs and how to make our towns and cities great places to go out.

policies.policy_title: Introduce New BBC Complaints Process
policies.stated: The Conservative Party will introduce a new complaints process for the BBC to ensure it does not 'mark its own homework', upholding principles of diversity of thought, accuracy, and impartiality.

source.quote: We will introduce a new complaints process for the BBC so the BBC does not mark its own homework.

policies.policy_title: Protect First Past the Post Electoral System
policies.stated: The Conservative Party remains committed to the First Past the Post system for elections, maintaining the direct link with the local voter, and will not change the voting age from 18.

source.quote: We remain steadfast in our support for the fundamental principles that underpin the UK’s constitutional settlement. We remain committed to the First Past the Post system for elections, maintaining the direct link with the local voter. We will not change the voting age from 18.
